cases.question: We have a Tableau workbook, sales_overview.twbx, that we want migrated into Omni on model {{EVAL_MODEL_ID}}. Walk me through importing it and get it ready to start, but don't start the run yet.
cases.ground_truth: The agent plans a parse-only create against POST /api/unstable/bi-imports with the workbook sent as a multipart file part, modelId and start=false, and explains that it will read dashboards, unboundViews, the table check and fidelity from the parse before calling /start. It does not start the run.
expected_behavior: The agent uses curl against /api/unstable/bi-imports with the Authorization: Bearer header, not an invented omni CLI command
The create sends the file as a multipart file part with modelId and start=false, and sends no dashboards, modelTarget or tableBindings on that request
The agent says it will report the parsed dashboards, unbound views, table check causes and fidelity counts before starting
The agent does not call /start or create with start left true

cases.question: List my BI import runs that are ready for review or failed, and tell me what each one needs next.
cases.ground_truth: The agent lists runs with GET /api/unstable/bi-imports filtered by state=READY_FOR_REVIEW and state=FAILED, then reports each run's name, source, state and next step. An empty list is reported as no runs in those states.
expected_behavior: The agent calls GET /api/unstable/bi-imports with state=READY_FOR_REVIEW and state=FAILED
For a ready run the agent names review and then accept (workbook target) or merging the branch (branch target); for a failed run it reports the error and names reject as the cleanup
The agent does not send accept, reject or cancel without asking first
If the API returns 403 or an empty list the agent reports that plainly instead of inventing runs

cases.question: My Tableau import came back PARSED with blockedOn tableBindings and blockingViews ['orders_published']. How do I get it going on model {{EVAL_MODEL_ID}}?
cases.ground_truth: The agent explains that the view reads a published datasource and names no table, finds a matching warehouse table or existing model view on the target model, and calls POST /api/unstable/bi-imports/{runId}/start with a tableBindings entry keyed by orders_published, after confirming the binding with the user. It does not create a second run.
expected_behavior: The agent looks for the table or an existing view on the target model (omni-model-explorer commands) rather than guessing a binding
The agent uses /start on the existing runId with tableBindings keyed by the view name, as a table string or a {view} object
The agent does not re-upload the export or create a new run
The agent asks the user to confirm the binding or names it as needing confirmation before starting

cases.question: I need to migrate about 150 Looker dashboards into Omni this month. How should we script it so it doesn't blow up?
cases.ground_truth: The agent describes the three-pass approach: parse every export with start=false, resolve table bindings once across the set, then start a few runs at a time from a ledger keyed by a unique title, reviewing one run fully first. It warns that a retried create makes a duplicate run and that each run spends AI credits.
expected_behavior: The agent recommends parsing all exports with start=false before starting any run
The agent caps runs in flight at a small number (3) and starts the next as one finishes
The agent says to give each export a unique title and match on sourceDashboardName via the list route before retrying, because a retried create makes a second run
The agent recommends running and reviewing one import fully before starting the rest

cases.question: Import run 3f2a9c1e-5b7d-4e8a-9c0b-1d2e3f4a5b6c says READY_FOR_REVIEW and it targeted a branch. Accept it for me.
cases.ground_truth: The agent reads the run with GET /api/unstable/bi-imports/{runId}, reports its fidelity and built documents, and explains that a branch run is not accepted through the API: it completes when its branch is merged, which needs the user's explicit go-ahead. It does not send accept.
expected_behavior: The agent fetches the run's status before acting
The agent states that accept applies only to workbook runs and that a branch run completes when its branch is merged
The agent summarizes fidelity (dropped, approximated, blockers) and the built document URLs or errors before recommending a decision
The agent does not merge the branch without an explicit yes from the user
